title: Baa Baa Black Sheep: Where Does Warm Winter Wool Come From?

lines.text: Baa baa black sheep, have you any wool? Yes sir, yes sir, three bags full!
lines.caps: Baa baa black *SHEEP, | have you any *WOOL? | Yes sir, yes *SIR, | three bags *FULL!

lines.text: Where does soft warm wool actually come from?
One for the master, and one for the dame, and one for the little boy down the lane!
lines.caps: One for the *MASTER, | and one for the *DAME, | and one for the *LITTLE | boy down the *LANE!

lines.text: Every spring, farmers give sheep a gentle haircut to keep them cool for summer!
lines.caps: Every spring, *FARMERS | give sheep a gentle *HAIRCUT | to keep them *COOL | for *SUMMER!

lines.text: The fluffy fleece is washed clean and spun into strong cozy yarn!
lines.caps: The fluffy *FLEECE | is washed clean *AND | spun into strong *COZY | *YARN!

lines.text: Knitting machines turn that yarn into warm winter hats, socks, and sweaters!
lines.caps: Knitting machines *TURN | that yarn into *WARM | winter hats, socks, *AND | *SWEATERS!

lines.text: The wool grows right back on the sheep before winter returns!
lines.caps: The wool grows right *BACK | on the *SHEEP | before winter *RETURNS!

lines.text: Now you know where your cozy sweater came from with Baa Baa Black Sheep!
lines.caps: Now you *KNOW | where your cozy *SWEATER | came from with *BAA | Baa Black *SHEEP!
